annotations.title: Answer a reply from a found person

description: Answer one reply someone wrote back, as a reply in the same conversation, from the inbox it came to (it must be the inbox of whoever approved this connection), once the person has approved the exact text: it reaches a real person in their name. Start from the reply's draftAnswer when there is one. includeJoinLink: true puts their personal join link under the answer; leave it false while the conversation is not about joining yet. LinkJolt adds the unsubscribe and privacy lines either way. Refused, with the reason, for a no, a bounce or an away message, a reply in a teammate's inbox, someone who joined or said no, an invitation that ran out when the join link is asked for, or the day's sending limit. A reply something already went back to is refused unless writeAgain is true. Requires Pro plan or higher.

body.description: The answer, as the person approved it, without the lines LinkJolt adds under it

includeJoinLink.description: Put their join link under the answer (default false)

messageId.description: The reply, from list_prospect_replies or get_prospect

writeAgain.description: true only when the person asked to answer a reply something already went back to (default false)
